run_char_stat_cli: run the char_stat script with --src flag to generate character statistics from a source tree
generate_statistics_function: generate character frequency statistics from all files in a directory recursively
count_characters_function: count occurrences of each character in files or directories recursively
review_generate_statistics: review the generate_statistics function that returns a dictionary of character counts
refactor_count_characters: refactor the count_characters function to use collections.Counter for cleaner code
